entry.notes: representation gap invalid-utf8 of the js table (registry/gaps/js.toml): @stellar/stellar-sdk xdr string<> as string (UTF-16 code units) or Uint8Array. an xdr string is bytes and need not be UTF-8. scValToNative returns such a string as a Uint8Array, and a Uint8Array used as an object property key turns into its comma-joined decimal bytes, so the string 0xff and the string "255" land on one key. 17.2.1 scValToNative returns { "255": 2 } for {string 0x323535: 1, string 0xff: 2}, one entry lost; 17.3.0 and 17.4.0 throw (scvMap has more than one key that converts to "255")
